text:
Type: black gooseneck LED desk lamp
Use: focused task light for reading and working at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: flexible metal gooseneck arm, matte black plastic, small LED spotlight head, weighted round base
Colors: matte black, white cord
Shape: tall slender S-curved gooseneck rising from a flat round base, tiny bell-shaped head that bends in any direction, light and graphic, compact footprint
Feel: sleek, practical, understated
Goes with: white or light wood desks, black accents, grey walls; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern home offices

product.name: JANSJ
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
